title: Shortcut Sensitivity in Agent-Safety Evaluations
abstract: arXiv:2610.22243v1 Announce Type: new  Abstract: AI agents take actions through tools. Some actions are sensitive, so guards that supervise them must themselves be evaluated reliably. Yet the data used to evaluate a guard can include cues that make labels predictable without measuring the intended safety construct, and those cues can also influence guard decisions. We introduce a three-level shortcut-auditing framework and audit completed LinuxArena trajectories and two TS-Bench-derived step datasets. We distinguish label predictability, observational guard association, and paired decision sensitivity. In LinuxArena, shorter average shell commands strongly predict trajectory labels. In AgentDojo-Traj, exact-tool lookup falls from F_1=.901 with mixed-domain folds to .495 under domain holdout. In AgentHarm-Traj, released TS-Guard F_1 falls from .902 under row weighting to .719 with equal interaction weighting, while balanced accuracy rises. We then test the strongest safe-row marker asso

translated_title: 智能体安全评估中的捷径敏感性
translated_abstract: AI智能体通过工具来执行操作。部分操作是敏感的，因此监督这些操作的防护机制本身必须得到可靠的评估。然而，用于评估防护机制的数据可能包含某些线索，使得标签无需测量预期的安全构念即可被预测，而这些线索也可能影响防护机制的决策。我们提出了一个三层级的捷径审计框架，并对已完成的LinuxArena轨迹以及两个由TS-Bench派生的步骤数据集进行了审计。我们区分了标签可预测性、观察性防护关联以及配对决策敏感性。在LinuxArena中，较短的平均shell命令能强烈预测轨迹标签。在AgentDojo-Traj中，精确工具查找的F1值从混合领域折数下的.901降至领域留出下的.495。在AgentHarm-Traj中，已发布的TS-Guard的F1值在行加权下为.902，而在等交互加权下降至.719，同时平衡准确率反而上升。随后，我们测试了最强的安全行标记关联……（摘要原文在此处截断）
tldr: 该论文提出一个三层级捷径审计框架，揭示智能体安全防护评估数据中存在的捷径线索（如命令长度、领域混叠、加权方式）会显著夸大防护机制的表观性能（F1可从约0.90跌至0.50–0.72），因此安全评估必须控制这些捷径才能得出可靠结论。
en_tdlr: This paper introduces a three-level shortcut-auditing framework and shows that shortcut cues in agent-safety guard evaluation data (such as command length, domain leakage, and weighting schemes) can substantially inflate apparent guard performance (F1 dropping from ~0.90 to 0.50–0.72), underscoring that safety evaluations must control for such shortcuts to yield reliable conclusions.
